{{Top|leg}}
'''R''' was a mysterious [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] who owned a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]], the Jedi [[Trilinae Untaire]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Milinae Untaire]] attempted to discover R's true identity, but they were unable to find out much about the gangster and did not even know what [[Gender/Legends|gender]] the criminal was. Around this time, R destroyed Milinae's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and the smuggler subsequently attempted to steal a [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] from R's space station, as a replacement.
